description: Fix 4 production blockers: (1) req.user→req.auth mapping in integrations.ts so all routes stop crashing, (2) ShopifyProvider self-registration so providerRegistry.getProvider('shopify') succeeds, (3) ENCRYPTION_KEY production guard in crypto.ts + .env.example update, (4) add project_integrations and integration_tools to enable-rls.mjs. Also fix 3 secondary bugs: (5) replace dynamic require() with top-level import for refundUsage in tool-execution.ts, (6) fix RBAC viewer check in authorize/revoke to use req.auth.memberships, (7) add 10-second AbortController timeout to Shopify safeFetch.
steps: Step 1 — Fix req.auth mapping in backend/api-server/src/routes/projects/integrations.ts. Replace ALL occurrences of req.user.organizationId with (req as any).auth?.memberships?.[0]?.organizationId resolved via withBypassRLS project lookup (same pattern as projects/index.ts lines 204-213). Replace req.user.id with (req as any).auth?.userId. The connect, verify, authorize, and revoke route handlers each need this fix. Pattern: (1) resolve project from projectId with withBypassRLS to get project.organizationId, (2) find membership matching that org in auth.memberships, (3) use membership.role for RBAC. See projects/index.ts lines 208-222 for the exact pattern to replicate.

Step 2 — Fix ShopifyProvider registration in backend/api-server/src/services/integrations/providers/shopify.ts. Add at the bottom of the file, after the class definition: `import { providerRegistry } from '../provider-registry'; providerRegistry.register(new ShopifyProvider());` — this makes the existing side-effect import in integrations.ts trigger registration.

Step 3 — Add ENCRYPTION_KEY production guard in database/db/src/crypto.ts. After the existing ENCRYPTION_KEY line, add: `if (!process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') { throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_KEY must be set in production. Refusing to start with fallback key.'); }`. Also add ENCRYPTION_KEY= to .env.example (at workspace root d:/Project/Chat-bot/.env.example) with a comment.

Step 4 — Add integration tables to scripts/enable-rls.mjs. In the `tables` array, add 'project_integrations' and 'integration_tools'. Also add 'security_audit_logs', 'project_entitlements', 'consumed_confirmations', 'browser_capabilities' which are also missing from the current list.

Step 5 — Fix dynamic require() in backend/api-server/src/services/tool-execution.ts. Move refundUsage to the top-level import on line ~13: change `import { checkAndIncrementUsage } from '../security/quota'` to `import { checkAndIncrementUsage, refundUsage } from '../security/quota'`. Delete the inline `const { refundUsage } = require('../../security/quota')` at line ~412.

Step 6 — Fix RBAC viewer check in integrations.ts authorize and revoke handlers. Replace `if (req.user.role === 'viewer')` with a proper membership check using the project's organizationId resolved in Step 1. Pattern: `if (!isSuperAdmin && (!membership || !['owner', 'admin', 'manager'].includes(membership.role))) { return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Insufficient permissions' }); }` — consistent with the pattern in projects/index.ts.

Step 7 — Add AbortController timeout to safeFetch in backend/api-server/src/services/integrations/providers/shopify.ts. At the top of safeFetch, create `const controller = new AbortController(); const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000);`. Add `signal: controller.signal` to safeOptions. Wrap the fetch in try/finally to call `clearTimeout(timeoutId)`. Catch AbortError and re-throw as `new Error('Provider timeout: Shopify API did not respond within 10 seconds.')`.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npx tsc --noEmit` from backend/api-server/ reports zero errors in integrations.ts, tool-execution.ts, and shopify.ts
Running `node -e "const r = require('./dist/services/integrations/provider-registry'); console.log(r.providerRegistry.hasProvider('shopify'))"` returns true after build (or equivalent tsx check)
A POST to /api/projects/:projectId/integrations/connect with a valid Bearer token returns 400 (invalid provider) or 200, NOT 500 TypeError
Running `npx tsx tests/phase2f-verification.test.ts` from backend/api-server/ with DATABASE_URL set — all existing tests continue to pass
Running `npx tsx tests/tenant-isolation.test.ts` — all assertions pass
crypto.ts throws in production mode when ENCRYPTION_KEY is absent
scripts/enable-rls.mjs table list includes project_integrations and integration_tools
verification: npx tsx tests/phase2f-verification.test.ts  (from d:/Project/Chat-bot/backend/api-server/ — all PASS)
npx tsx tests/tenant-isolation.test.ts  (from d:/Project/Chat-bot/backend/api-server/ — all PASS)

npx tsx -e "import { providerRegistry } from './src/services/integrations/provider-registry'; import './src/services/integrations/providers/shopify'; console.log(providerRegistry.hasProvider('shopify'));"  (from d:/Project/Chat-bot/backend/api-server/ — prints true)
findings: All 7 steps implemented and verified. Changes made: (1) integrations.ts fully rewritten — replaced all req.user.organizationId with resolveAuthContext() helper using withBypassRLS + req.auth?.memberships (mirrors projects/index.ts pattern). Added withBypassRLS import. (2) shopify.ts — changed import to include providerRegistry; added providerRegistry.register(new ShopifyProvider()) at bottom of file. Verified: npx tsx -e confirms hasProvider('shopify') returns true. (3) crypto.ts — added production guard that throws if ENCRYPTION_KEY unset and NODE_ENV=production; .env.example updated with ENCRYPTION_KEY= entry and generation comment. (4) enable-rls.mjs — added project_integrations, integration_tools, security_audit_logs, project_entitlements, consumed_confirmations, browser_capabilities to tables array. (5) tool-execution.ts — moved refundUsage to top-level import alongside checkAndIncrementUsage; removed inline require(). (6) integrations.ts authorize/revoke — replaced req.user.role==='viewer' check with proper isSuperAdmin+membership.role check including owner/admin/manager. (7) shopify.ts safeFetch — added AbortController with 10s timeout, try/finally clearTimeout, AbortError re-thrown as descriptive Provider timeout error. Test results: tsc --noEmit: 0 errors. phase2f-verification.test.ts: 96/96 PASSED. tenant-isolation.test.ts: 4/4 PASSED. providerRegistry.hasProvider('shopify'): true.
